title: Street Stall Identity Continuity
description: Four reference-linked street-food brand images establishing a coherent vernacular stall identity.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the stall materials, painted-sign rhythm, wrapper palette, and lighting mood. Images 02-04 preserve that same identity kit while rotating handheld hero food, condiment logic, and night-market service use.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-stall-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
